result.method: BigInt rational deterministic failure-prefix/cycle elimination, occupancy-monotone memoized recursion, and an exact fair global H/V mixture.
result.stoppingConvention: Stop at geometric jam or first state whose entire failure orbit has no legal output. Count preceding sampled trials; omit the infinite blocked tail.

kineticDefinitions.expectedAttemptsPerParticle: E[A/N], from terminal-outcome-weighted attempt rewards; not E[A]/E[N]

result.limitations: Expected attempts are finite pre-recognition cost, not a waiting time to a success after deadlock. Exact geometry is limited to L<=3.
